provenance: Second pass on professional and technical convention: commit-message conventions (the gitmoji vocabulary), incident response, and the emerging visual grammar of AI product interfaces.

✨.gloss: In the gitmoji convention sparkles specifically mean a new feature — which collides awkwardly with sparkles having become the universal AI-feature icon.

🐎.gloss: An older gitmoji for speed improvements, largely displaced by ⚡.

🚑.gloss: A gitmoji marking an emergency patch to production.

🔖.gloss: The gitmoji for cutting a version.

🚨.gloss: A specific gitmoji sense that sits oddly beside the same glyph meaning 'production incident' elsewhere.

🏗️.gloss: Structural refactoring rather than a feature.

⬆️.gloss: Bumping a version; ⬇️ is the downgrade.

🗑️.gloss: Removing code or retiring a feature.

💥.gloss: The gitmoji warning that an API contract has changed.

🚀.gloss: Deploying, as distinct from 🚢 shipping a release.

🧪.gloss: Marks work not yet generally available.

🟩.gloss: Green squares as CI status in dashboards and standups.

🟧.gloss: The middle tier of a status-page colour scheme.

🔺.gloss: Incident severity marking in on-call channels.

📟.gloss: The pager survives as the icon for on-call alerting long after the device disappeared.

🪵.gloss: A pun on log files that has become genuinely common in observability tooling.

🔍.gloss: Interface metaphor, and a request to look something up.

🪄.gloss: The magic wand became a standard AI-action affordance in product UI around 2023.

🧵.gloss: In systems contexts the literal computing sense, colliding with the social-media 'thread of posts' reading.

🧊.gloss: Pinned versions, alongside the icebox and cold-storage senses.

🧱.gloss: A dependency preventing progress, in standup notation.

🪦.gloss: Marking a product or version as discontinued in changelogs.

🤝.gloss: Pair programming, or a cross-team handoff.

📈.sense: the only chart in the deck
📈.gloss: Used sardonically about metrics chosen to flatter.

⏳.gloss: Blocked on review or approval rather than on work.

🫡.sense: acknowledging a decision one disagrees with
🫡.gloss: The distinctive corporate register of the salute: compliance without endorsement.

🙏.gloss: In work channels this is a request marker, not gratitude and certainly not prayer.
